mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong residential construction activity, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between HOUST and 20d SPX returns is <= 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS (when >5.0%) and 20d SPX returns is <= 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) signals a deteriorating labor market, which is a leading indicator of economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and PAYEMS falls > 100000 in 1 month
failure_condition: Rank IC between the interaction of UNRATE and PAYEMS (as defined by the trigger condition) and 20d SPX returns is <= 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by GDP growth above 3% and CPIAUCSL annual growth below 3%), the S&P 500 is prone to a correction, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 3% and CPIAUCSL annual growth rate < 3%
failure_condition: Rank IC between the regime condition (GDPC1 growth >3% and CPIAUCSL annual growth <3%) and 60d SPX returns is <= 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL annual growth rate is below 2.0%, it indicates stable inflation, which is favorable for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between CPIAUCSL (when annual growth <2.0%) and 5d SPX returns is <= 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong industrial production (INDPRO > 110) combined with high housing starts (HOUST > 1600) indicates robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the interaction of INDPRO and HOUST (as defined by the trigger condition) and 20d SPX returns is <= 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between PAYEMS and 20d SPX returns is <= 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS below 5.0%), the Federal Reserve's accommodative policy reduces risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS (when <5.0%) and 60d SPX returns is <= 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
